name: What Was Written Over
story: A page was scraped clean and written over, and the older text keeps rising between the lines.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: The sheet lies under the lamp with its first hand scraped off. A second hand has written over it.

beforeStory.speaker: Erased Clerk
beforeStory.text: I copy what is on top. What is underneath is not mine to read.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: Arith puts two fingers on the corner and holds the page flat. The clerk writes around his hand.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: The warden turns the page over. On the back, the older hand has written the same sentence twice.

afterStory.speaker: Margin Warden
afterStory.text: Leave it in the tray. Someone still has to sign the bottom of it.

name: The Page Nobody Signed
story: The archive asks for a signature, and it does not accept a borrowed hand.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: The clerk sets the page down and lays the pen across the bottom line. The line is empty.

beforeStory.speaker: Clerk
beforeStory.text: Your own hand. The page can tell a mark that was made for you.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: Arith leaves the pen where it lies. The clerk draws the page back and waits.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: Arith presses his bare palm on the page and holds it there until the ink takes.

afterStory.speaker: Warden
afterStory.text: One hand signed it. The next page will ask for the other.

name: The Page Returned
story: The copyist will give the page back, but not with a witness in the room.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: The copyist sits with the page under both hands. He has not looked up since Arith came in.

beforeStory.speaker: Chief Copyist
beforeStory.text: Send the others out. What I hand over does not pass in front of a witness.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: Arith shuts the door and stands with his back against it. The clerks outside do not knock.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: The copyist pushes the page across the desk and folds his hands. In the corridor, Sable is waiting with a pen and no paper.

afterStory.speaker: Chief Copyist
afterStory.text: Take her with you. She asked for a page of her own, and I am finished giving her mine.

chapter: Chapter III - The Quiet Reading Room
name: The Quiet Reading Room
story: One room in the archive is still quiet, and the warden means to keep it that way.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: The reading room keeps three lamps lit and no one at the table. The chairs are pushed in.

beforeStory.speaker: Reading Room Warden
beforeStory.text: Sit or stand or go. Do not turn two pages at once.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: Arith rests one hand on a chair back. The warden watches the hand, not the door.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: The warden sets the chairs straight and lowers each lamp by a finger's width.

afterStory.speaker: Reading Room Warden
afterStory.text: The room stays quiet. If you come back, come back with fewer people.

chapter: Chapter III - The Quiet Reading Room
name: A Name in the Margin
story: Someone wrote a name in the margin, and every reader since has tried to rub it out.

beforeStory.speaker: Reader
beforeStory.text: Do not say the name in the margin out loud. They come to check the ones who do.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: Arith puts his thumb over the name and holds it there. The readers come around the table.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: Arith lifts his thumb. The name is faint, but it is still on the page.

afterStory.speaker: Reader
afterStory.text: Copy it onto your own paper. This page will not hold it.

chapter: Chapter III - The Quiet Reading Room
name: The Last Reader
story: The last reader has not left the room in a long time, and the room has filled up around her.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: The last reader sits with her back to the shelves. The wardens stand between her and the door.

beforeStory.speaker: Last Reader
beforeStory.text: I have not finished this page. Standing there will not finish it faster.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: Arith closes the door behind him. The clerk marks the hour on the frame and steps away.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: The last reader turns the page. It is the same page she was reading when Arith came in.

afterStory.speaker: Last Reader
afterStory.text: Leave the lamp lit. I will finish it before the oil does.
